What to find: Known technical limitations, risks and failure modes.
Card sections that often contain it: Limitations, Bias, Risks and Limitations

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Models can easily be prompted to generate harmful and sensitive content (no safety filtering); such content may also be produced unintentionally, especially involving bias; statements are often inaccurate, so facts should be verified.
quotes: Like any base language model or fine-tuned model without safety filtering, these models can easily be prompted by users to generate harmful and sensitive content.
Such content may also be produced unintentionally, especially in cases involving bias, so we recommend that users consider the risks when applying this technology.
Additionally, many statements from OLMo or any LLM are often inaccurate, so facts should be verified.
